comparisons.reason: Both read OC_comments and give 0 for an empty list and null for malformed input. They differ in construct. Left is 1 for any specific real-world example cited as support, which covers any event, person, study or case used as evidence. Right is 1 only when a comment draws an analogy or comparison to a named real-world case and uses it to argue against the OP. Right is narrower in two ways: it requires an analogy or comparison, and it requires an argument against the OP. A cited study or statistic used as direct evidence counts on the left but not on the right. Left also counts examples that support any argument, including agreement with the OP.
